messages:
anya: Heads-up — noticed weirdness when regional circuit-breaker kicks in: downstream header `x-region-prefer` isn't preserved on failover, so routing sticky cookies and tenant quotas don't line up. Repro on staging.
kevin: hmm — is the header stripped by the edge or overwritten during proxy handoff?
anya: looks like overwrite. Trace shows:
```
Edge -> service-a (region=eu) returns 503
Edge fallback -> service-b (region=us) request headers: x-region-prefer: null
```
samir: we intentionally drop some routing headers for security, but we should re-add an override header when doing failover. Otherwise affinity and quota attribution get confused and cause double-counts.
mika: what's the minimal safe change? Add `x-redwood-fallback-region` with the original region, and keep `x-region-prefer` immutable? Or preserve `x-region-prefer` only for internal tenants?
kevin: prefer adding `x-redwood-fallback-region` and making routing precedence: explicit override header > x-redwood-fallback-region > inferred client region. That avoids stale preference poisoning normal routing. Also requires we mark fallback header as read-only to downstreams.
anya: agreed. Also need telemetry: emit an event `route.failover` with fields {tenant, from_region, to_region, reason}. Console needs that to surface failover rates per-tenant so rollouts don't look like regressions.
infra-bot: CI: routing-config-v2 unit tests ✅, integration header-propagation test ❌ — see CI#4521
samir: i'll update the proxy shim to copy preserved headers on 502/503 failover paths and emit the telemetry event. Will add unit+integration tests for header precedence and quota attribution.
kevin: can we gate via a rollout flag? We'd like to canary this per-tenant and have a console toggle `preserve-failover-headers` so SEs can opt-in.
mika: UX note: toggle should include small changelog text: "Changes how quotas and affinity are attributed during failover. May change billing telemetry temporarily."
anya: yep. i can add the short note + telemetry graphs in the rollouts page. Also add a link to the integration test logs.
samir: PR incoming in ~2 hours, will include docs, tests, and a flag default-off.
kevin: perfect. after canary we'll monitor `route.failover` and quota deltas for the first 24h. :thumbsup:
anya: thanks — removing flaky alert for staging until PR lands.
infra-bot: deployment checklist updated: remember to run `tools/regenerate-routes --validate-headers` before canary rollout.
